title: SEC2: LogEntry cloned per trusted key in verify loop
description: In xcid_client.rs line 216, verify_signature() takes entry by value, so the loop clones the LogEntry on every iteration: 'if let Ok(verified) = verify_signature(entry.clone(), key)'. If an operator configures N trusted keys, N-1 unnecessary heap allocations occur before a match is found. Fix: refactor verify_signature to take &LogEntry (borrowing) or restructure the loop to avoid cloning until a match is confirmed.
